investigator.method: Bounded, single unauthenticated Level-1 PASSIVE_STATIC GET (curl, descriptive User-Agent, redirects followed, 20s timeout, no retry, no authentication, no CAPTCHA/challenge bypass, no browser) against the venue's official_website (falling back to official_programme_url where noted), as part of BEATMAPPED-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01 batch 6 of 7.

probe_history.reason: A single unauthenticated Level-1 static GET against https://www.chickenshed.org.uk/calendar retained enough real evidence (event/programme listing content, title/meta tags, and structured data where present) to reach an honest, evidenced REJECT decision without needing to escalate to Level 2/3/4.

identity.notes: Retained footer excerpt from the official domain literally states '290 Chase Side, London N14 4PE', which matches the candidate's discovery address (Chase Side 290, N14 4PE, London).

site_classification.platform: Server-rendered static HTML event/calendar cards (no JSON-LD Event schema observed in this bounded probe).

venue_location.notes: Retained footer excerpt on the official domain states '290 Chase Side, London N14 4PE', matching the discovery-supplied address.

reasons: The retained calendar excerpt shows the venue's current 'Upcoming events' list is dominated by theatre/inclusive-arts productions and workshops (Planet Play, Tales from the Shed, Adult Acting Workshops, Children's Performance Project, Adult Musical Theatre Workshop, Young People's Performance Project) — Chickenshed's own meta description also self-identifies it as 'a theatre company for absolutely everyone'.

Only 2 of the 12 retained upcoming-event titles are music-oriented (Street 22 - Music Night; Jo Collins & Friends live-music evening), plus a Community Choir class — a small minority of a primarily theatre/inclusive-arts/education programme, not a substantially music-led venue per the BeatMapped venue-level music gate.

evidence.description: Retained, bounded, genuine excerpts (contiguous literal substrings) of the actual HTTP response body from a single unauthenticated GET, plus response metadata (status/content-type/title); JSON wrapper around literal excerpt strings, so not byte-faithful as a whole file.
evidence.method: curl -L (redirects followed); descriptive User-Agent; unauthenticated GET; 20-second timeout; no retry; no browser/JS execution.
